summary: Iteration 49 — End-to-end validation of the new 'Ver Comprobante' bank-transfer proof viewer on admin notification modal. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_bank_transfer_proof_notification.py with 8 pytest cases covering auth gate (anonymous + non-admin user → 401/403), validation (missing params → 400 'Indique reference o payment_id', unknown reference and payment_id → 404 'Transferencia no encontrada'), happy path (reference TEST-216389 → 200 with payload {payment, data_uri starts data:image/png;base64,, filename='comprobante.png', has_file=true} plus full payment metadata: user_name='Jorge Lamberti', user_email='jlamberti.carso.cr@gmail.com', amount=4850, currency='EUR' — no _id leakage), lookup by payment_id, and whitespace-tolerant reference lookup. Result: 8/8 PASS in 6.82s (junit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter49_bank_transfer_proof_notif.xml). Frontend Playwright E2E (admin login → bell → notification modal): (1) admin login OK, (2) bell dropdown opens, (3) seeded notif click opens notification-detail-modal, (4) notif-view-proof-btn renders and is visible only on bank-transfer notifications, (5) clicking it loads inline notif-proof-viewer WITHOUT closing the parent dialog, (6) image renders with src starting 'data:image/png;base64,', (7) notif-proof-download and notif-proof-open buttons present with href set to the data URI, (8) metadata footer contains Ref TEST-216389, Monto 4850, Usuario Jorge Lamberti, (9) modal remains visible alongside the new viewer, (10) Agregar Saldo al Usuario button still rendered below the viewer, (11) clicking notif-proof-close collapses the viewer and re-shows notif-view-proof-btn, (12) Negative control: a 'Nuevo Retiro' notification (TEST-CONTROL) shows ZERO Ver Comprobante buttons in its modal.
critical_code_review_comments: review_request stated notification items have data-testid='notification-<id>' but actual implementation uses 'notification-item-<id>'. Not a bug, but worth aligning task docs / test fixtures so future agents don't waste cycles on wrong selectors.

/app/backend/routes/misc.py admin_get_bank_transfer_proof projects payment fields but does NOT exclude the 'data' field on the proof document (it does select it, that's needed). However the base64 'data' is concatenated as data_uri with naive guessing of mime by extension only — if the proof_filename has unexpected extension (.tif, .heic, .docx) the response falls through to application/octet-stream which the inline tag cannot render. Consider detecting the binary header (PNG/JPEG/PDF magic bytes) and refusing/transcoding unsupported types with a clear UI message.

The endpoint loads the FULL base64 file into memory and returns it inline as JSON. For PDFs / large images, this duplicates payload size by ~33% and forces the SPA to hold the data URI in React state. Consider returning a short-lived signed URL or a streaming GET endpoint /api/admin/bank-transfer/proof/file for files > 256 KB.

Frontend handleViewProof reads token directly from localStorage instead of using the central safeApiCall helper used elsewhere in NotificationBell — inconsistent and bypasses any refresh-token logic. Consolidate.

getBankTransferReference relies on Spanish substring 'transferencia bancaria' in the notif title. If notification titles ever get i18n'd (English admin: 'New Bank Transfer'), the button silently disappears. Trigger should also accept type === 'bank_transfer' on the notification document.

No 'Cerrar' / 'Cancelar' button inside the inline viewer for mobile users with small screens — only the icon-X (data-testid notif-proof-close). The icon is fine on desktop but a labeled button is more discoverable on phones. Minor UX.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 2 notifications for the real admin (id=ed6340b1-9efb-492e-9417-4ffbd519615a): (a) id=7a216918-2584-4399-b6a2-13fecb7d539d title='Nueva Transferencia Bancaria' message containing 'Referencia: TEST-216389' + Jorge Lamberti + 4850 EUR — used as positive trigger; (b) id=1afd7e74-ba3e-432b-900d-2e59924930cb title='Nuevo Retiro' message 'Referencia: TEST-CONTROL.' — used as negative control. Existing seed payment in bank_transfer_payments(reference=TEST-216389) and bank_transfer_proofs(filename=comprobante.png, 1x1 PNG) was already present from previous iteration. Also created a non-admin user TEST_proofviewer_user@example.com / TestPwd2026! to verify role gate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_bank_transfer_proof_notification.py (8 tests, ~7s). Frontend testids on the modal: notif-view-proof-btn, notif-proof-viewer, notif-proof-content, notif-proof-image, notif-proof-pdf, notif-proof-empty, notif-proof-download, notif-proof-open, notif-proof-close. Notification dropdown rows are 'notification-item-<id>' (NOT 'notification-<id>' as the review_request claimed). Bell button testid is 'notification-bell' but Playwright reports it as not visible by default — workaround: use page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"notification-bell\"]').click()") to bypass visibility heuristic. Seed notifs left in DB (TEST-216389 + TEST-CONTROL) are safe to keep — they're already wired to the demo bank-transfer record. The seeded 1x1 PNG renders as a tiny square in the viewer (expected; this is the smoke seed, not a real comprobante). To test the 'No hay comprobante' empty state via UI, insert a notification with Referencia pointing to a nonexistent ref — the backend will 404 and the frontend correctly surfaces 'No hay comprobante disponible para esta transferencia.' (verified via direct backend test, not via UI in this iteration).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end on first review. One self-inflicted Playwright friction: review_request stated notification items use 'notification-<id>' but actual code uses 'notification-item-<id>', causing two failed locator attempts before DOM inspection revealed the correct format. Also the 'notification-bell' button passes Playwright's visibility check intermittently due to surrounding badge overlay; using direct JS click resolves it. Both are testing artefacts, no product bugs.
